_comment: The entry path: what entry.mjs prints on SessionStart when the session starts under root, in this order. `kit:` is a path under the plugin root; `brain:` is a path under this brain. Root CLAUDE.md is not listed because Claude Code loads it itself. An entry whose file is absent prints as MISSING: and is never skipped silently. Since DES-13 (2026-10-08) only what cannot be routed belongs here: the personal layer. Every clause arrives by route (hooks/route.mjs, <brain>/route-policy.json) with its owning file named.
